title: dryopteris drakei
intro: Dryopteris drakei, commonly known as the Pacific goldback fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used to treat a variety of health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris drakei include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
